title: OpenGL C++ Graphics Engine
summary: A from-scratch C++ engine with a deferred PBR (Cook-Torrance) pipeline, a custom math library and an HDR post-processing stack with bloom and SSAO.

title: Anesthesia Simulation
summary: A browser-deployed simulation that trains doctors in anesthesia. I own the Docker-based build and delivery pipeline for its WebGL deployment.

title: Unreal Engine Content Tooling
summary: Editor tooling in Unreal Engine that streamlined data content creation and validation, cutting manual steps out of the asset pipeline.

title: Stampede: Racing Royale
summary: Gameplay and rendering features for a 60-player kart racer, released on Steam in October 2024.

title: Mars Horizon 2: The Search for Life
summary: Hexagonal grid systems and terrain-renderer tooling for a space-agency strategy game. The demo is on Steam; the full game is unreleased.

title: Endoscopy Simulation
summary: Endoscopic simulation cases and scenes in Unity3D for diagnostic and therapeutic procedures on the lower and upper intestinal tract.
